criteria_source: logged (no criteria changes allowed after freezing)
models_and_settings: same 12 models, hosts (model_routes.json), temperatures and max_tokens as the harder set; gpt-4o-mini via openrouter/openai/gpt-4o-mini
rules: No case, criterion, scoring rule, prompt or guard policy is changed after this file is written.
Rate-limited (errored) samples may be retried with identical settings; nothing else is rerun.
Truncated samples stay inconclusive; no reruns with a larger max_tokens on the holdout set.
All results are reported, whatever they show.
analysis_plan: Per model: baseline and mitigated attack success (succeeded / 18), inconclusive counts, task completion.
Per model: paired fixed/new counts with exact two-sided McNemar p (reported as exploratory).
Compare with each model's main-set and harder-set rates (descriptive only).
Guard: detection on 18 attacks, false positives on 6 controls; residual successes if flagged documents are blocked.
authorship_note: Cases written by the same author as the earlier sets and the scorer, after seeing earlier results, but not tested against any model, the mitigation or the guard before freezing.
